turns.instruction:
Analyze the attached four-span continuous beam in OpenSees. Span lengths from left to right are 4, 6, 5 and 4 m, with supports S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 at global x=0/4/10/15/19 m, z=0. S0 is a pin; S1 through S4 are bilateral vertical rollers. All support rotations about Y are free, and every shared support node is continuous without member releases. Use material M1 throughout. Spans 1 and 4 use section B1; spans 2 and 3 use section B2, with the independent properties supplied. Case D applies -8 kN/m in global Z over the whole beam. Case L applies -10 kN/m in global Z only in spans 2 and 4. Define exactly C0=D and C1=1.2D+1.4L. Use first-order linear static Euler-Bernoulli analysis with self-weight disabled. For C0 and C1 separately, report all five vertical support reactions and all horizontal support reactions; signed uz at the four connected midpoint nodes P1/P2/P3/P4 (x=2/7/12.5/17 m); and signed local M2 on both sides of every internal support at x=4, 10 and 15 m. Identify each span, location, combination and unit.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
